data.content:
* * *

## [Don't expect any help from customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6705cc58726cbfe4d0a1bfbd)
I purchased the Elara bed and have been very disappointed that the headboard hasn't stayed upright like the website depicts, but rather it's floppy and always looks sloppy. I first asked what they recommend I do and they suggested I steam it. I tried that and it lasted about two hours until it was back to how it was. I've continued to reach out since I'm disappointed it doesn't look anything like the photos and I have to look at it multiple times per day in my primary bedroom. The customer service reply was basically "deal with it, not our problem." I'm super disappointed that they aren't willing to help me out as a (formerly) loyal customer.

October 2, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Oct 10, 2024

Hi Lauren,

Thank you for reaching out to us and sharing your experience. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you've faced with the Elara bed's headboard. We understand how frustrating it must be to not have it meet your expectations. According to our supplier, the behavior of the headboard is due to the natural characteristics of the linen fabric and is not considered a defect. We truly appreciate your feedback and are here to help if you have any further questions or concerns.
